name: @toros/contracts
description: Frozen types, error codes, and canonicalization shared by every Toros package. Do not edit as part of a unit slice.
_comment_entrypoints: tsconfig sets rootDir '.' so that src/ and test/ both compile, which puts the emitted entrypoint at dist/src/index.js — not dist/index.js. These paths must match that layout or every consumer fails with TS2307 'Cannot find module @toros/contracts'.
